title: fig-ds-time: where the hours go

title: fig-eye-dr: the fundus photographs
caption: Actual retinal images of the kind the DR screener grades — what 'gradable vs ungradable' looks like, and why blur and lighting are screening outcomes, not just image quality.

title: margin: the ROC pass corner
caption: Threshold sweep as feasibility test: the curve must reach the corner where Sens ≥ 0.90 and Spec ≥ 0.80 both hold. If no threshold lands there, the candidate fails before deployment questions start.

title: Monitoring loops span five orders of magnitude
caption: Log-scale ladder: minute-level camera checks up to quarterly architecture reviews. Cadence matches signal trustworthiness and remedy cost — thrashing vs silent decay is the failure pair.

title: fig-ml-lifecycle-feedback: the upstream return paths
caption: Named feedback routes across stages 2-6: data gaps trigger targeted collection, validation issues motivate augmentation, performance insights and deployment constraints route back to data prep and collection.

title: margin: the iteration tax
caption: 100 experiments at an hourly cycle vs 26 at a weekly one over six months — ~3.8× search breadth from cycle time alone.
